screening.samplingFinding: Two hundred forty-six predeclared final-cohort depth targets were acquired in isolated bounded headless runs; 239 captured successfully and 95 passed the unchanged structural evidence gates plus the eight-root query-relevance gate.
screening.visualValidationFinding: All ninety-five machine-pass site montages were inspected at original resolution, with individual original-resolution spot checks on dense desktop and narrow responsive captures. Every accepted page contains at least eight independent query-relevant product roots with visible title and price evidence. Ambiguous or absent package quantities are retained as valid abstention cases; pages with category drift, sparse results, or repeated shell content were rejected by the machine gate.

eligibility.reason: Independent human reviews and third-party adjudication are pending.
